entries.title: 1900: Max Planck discovers Planck's law of black-body radiation.
entries.summary: Max Karl Ernst Ludwig Planck was a German theoretical physicist. Planck made many contributions to theoretical physics, primarily in his role as the originator of quantum theory and one of the founders of modern physics, which revolutionized understanding of atomic and subatomic…

entries.title: 2025: Pieces of the French Crown Jewels are successfully stolen during a heist on the Louvre Museum in Paris.
entries.summary: The French Crown Jewels and Regalia comprise the crowns, orb, sceptres, diadems and jewels that were symbols of royal or imperial power between 752 and 1870. These were worn by many kings and queens of France as well as Emperor Napoleon.

entries.title: 2005: Saddam Hussein goes on trial in Baghdad for crimes against humanity.
entries.summary: Saddam Hussein Abd al-Majid al-Tikriti was an Iraqi politician and revolutionary who served as the fifth president of Iraq from 1979 until his overthrow in 2003. He also served as prime minister of Iraq from 1979 to 1991 and later from 1994 to 2003.
